seminarsPage.title: Seminars
seminarsPage.lead: Insight is a path in steps. You start with Insight I and then decide for yourself whether and when to go further. Each seminar stands on its own and builds on the one before.
seminarsPage.teensLead: For young people aged 14 to 19 there is Teen Insight: the same approach, fully tailored to their age.
seminarsPage.worldLead: Insight has existed since 1978 and is offered in several countries. Not based in Belgium, or travelling? See where else Insight takes place.
seminarsPage.doubtBody: That's completely normal. Come to a free info session and experience for yourself how Insight feels. You decide afterwards.
